title: The parked-tab canvas witness check
oneLine: Pixels noted on packed canvases, read back on return or rebuild; two empties trigger the recovery reload.
topConcern: Since v2.3.3702 the big packed sheets become images (canvas zeroed, witness skipped); worker-baked masked frames were never witnessed, so a purge can go unnoticed.

title: A made-once canvas kept as an image of itself
oneLine: A canvas source encoded to PNG, swapped to an , canvas zeroed; one stored promise dedupes asks.
topConcern: A toBlob that never calls back leaves the promise pending forever and the source unprotected.

title: Pictures kept on the graphics chip only
oneLine: Canvas emptied once uploaded (now, or once drawn via a pending set); a rebuilt renderer must remake them.
topConcern: keepOnGpuOnly has no lost-context guard; damage-font safety rests on a regex matching the font's install list.

title: A monster strip held as colour numbers once drawn
oneLine: Packed strip read to numbers after first draw, canvas emptied, refilled from numbers on any upload.
topConcern: Pending set drops destroyed sources only when a sweep runs; brief strong references between effects renderers.

title: The Wheel's monster looks, loaded as you walk toward them
oneLine: Per-look loading/ready/failed states by distance and land, freed after 10 s unused, reset on zone change.
topConcern: Freeing one look unloads a shared module (bogLurker/fishman) under a sibling still 'ready'; its monsters then draw as the generic brute.

title: Zone art bundles and the unload generation
oneLine: Per-bundle URLs and cropped strips, freed together; a generation number drops strips decoding across an unload.
topConcern: Assets-tracked loads (fireballs, remnants, footprints) are not generation-guarded; sequential unload awaits can destroy a re-entry's cached texture.

title: The world trial's streamed island ground
oneLine: Pieces of the ?trial=world island loaded near the camera, kept one ring out, freed beyond.
topConcern: A piece freed and re-wanted mid-load: the first arrival unloads the url under the second record.

title: Depth buckets: which side of the player each thing draws on
oneLine: Front/back layer per ground-standing child with 2 px hysteresis, plus the raise over a building's real base.
topConcern: On retired props the raise and the hysteresis disagree each frame, moving a figure twice a frame (both layers rebuilt).

title: A metal piece's shine: pooled filter or drawn in the frame
oneLine: Each metal sprite filtered, batched by the sheen batcher, or plain, chosen per frame and routed at draw-list build.
topConcern: Glint, sheen and fill programs are warmed once a page; after a black-screen rebuild the first armoured player compiles them mid-frame.

title: Colour-number atlas rows
oneLine: 256-row colour atlas: rows taken per picture, shared per bundle, per look; given back on destroy/unload.
topConcern: Correctness depends on unloadBundle destroying strips before giving their shared rows back.

title: Shadows: pieces, per-figure hold, pre-pass or filter
oneLine: Per-renderer shadow pools drawn by a pre-pass or a filter, a 1.5 s hold per caster, cleared on zone/sheet frees.
topConcern: Unused pooled meshes keep building textures (sprites drop theirs); safe only while every art free clears the systems first.

title: Light-and-shine switches and the Wheel's eased land light
oneLine: Per-device light and sheen switches with an on-to-off clear, and the Wheel light eased between lands.
topConcern: Turning light effects on at runtime leaves the shine programs unwarmed (gated on the switch at load).

title: The masked-body bake worker's state and replies
oneLine: Worker keeps the rod mask and parsed look sheets; every bake or look job gets one reply by id.
topConcern: A look sheet whose parse fails in the worker stays marked sent; its looks fall back to the old path silently.

title: Does this renderer draw colour numbers (one program or three)?
oneLine: Per-renderer palette and one-batch decision made by a prewarm draw and link check behind the loading screen.
topConcern: A rebuild whose prewarm fails to link still routes existing palette sources to the unlinked palette batcher.

title: Effects' colour numbers packed on the chip (p256)
oneLine: Dormant ?p256=1: numbers deflated once on the chip, unpacked before any upload, blank upload while packed.

title: A picture from a file held once (picsOnce)
oneLine: fx/ui pictures release their page copy once on the chip, restored from file on unload, loss or blank upload.
topConcern: A failed restore after a blank upload has no retry: a picture drawn every frame stays an empty texture until reload.

title: Which batcher draws a quad: the hook chain and install latches
oneLine: Up to five prototype wrappers route each quad and its rounding; page-life install latches for every Pixi patch.
topConcern: Routing depends on install order and whether each wrapper assigns before or after the inner chain; each claims the last word.

title: The farm's palette reader worker lifecycle
oneLine: png8 reader worker made on demand, stopped after 3 s idle or on error; failures load as pictures.
topConcern: test() and load() ask paletteFileFor separately; a decision between them falls back to the plain loader (harmless).

title: A look given up on, asked for again later
oneLine: Per-key retry rounds at 5/10/20/40/60 s, ten at most, started when a missing picture is asked for.
topConcern: Round counts never reset on success and due closures linger for keys nobody asks for again.

title: A frame that threw leaves Pixi's stacks open; heal closes them
oneLine: After a throwing render, stencil, colour mask, filter stack and sprite-mask stages reset to nothing open.
topConcern: Five Pixi-private fields; a rename makes the heal a silent no-op and the black screen returns.

title: Pixi's texture pool trimmed when idle or at a zone change
oneLine: Pooled scratch textures stamped when handed back, destroyed after 30 s idle or all at a zone change.

title: Which zone maps are resident (sync mirror of async cache)
oneLine: A Set mirroring Pixi's cache for the zone gate; live only for the farm's ground today.
topConcern: Mirror dropped before an awaited unload: a quick way back re-adds a texture the unload then destroys.

title: A live switch read where a sprite is packed
oneLine: Window switches boxed for the batchers; a flip marks every render group for a draw-list rebuild.

title: A big Graphics' building lists let go once drawn
oneLine: Unbatched, drawn, clean Graphics contexts have Pixi's geometry lists emptied; a redraw refills them.
topConcern: If Pixi rebuilds its GPU copy without marking the context dirty, the minimap draws from emptied lists, silently.
